Petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with Kotalpokhar P.S. Case No. 30 of 2022,
for the offences registered under Sections 341, 323, 504, 498A, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, pending in the court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Rajmahal at Sahibganj.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Rajmahal at Sahibganj
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Petitioner No.1 is the husband and petitioner No.2 is the married sister-in-law of the informant.
It is alleged that to enforce the demand of dowry, informant was tortured and ultimately she was driven away from matrimonial home.
Matter was referred for mediation to the Secretary, DLSA, Sahibganj.
Report of the mediation is on the record.
It appears that parties have settled their dispute.
Mr. Gautam Kumar, learned counsel for the opposite party No.2 has affirmed this fact.
Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioners on anticipatory bail.

They are directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order and learned court below on their surrender shall release Belaluddin Sheikh vs The State Of Jharkhand on 19 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191120317/
1 them on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/- (Twenty five Thousand only) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Rajmahal at Sahibganj in connection with Kotalpokhar P.S. Case No. 30 of 2022.
